description: Declare one hosted agent (reached over MCP or plain HTTP) and its skills, so AgenticPipelineComponent's `delegate` op can discover and dynamically pick it.

outputs.description: Declare-only agent card (lineage + metadata, no compute)

agent_id.label: Agent Id
agent_id.description: Stable id -- used by delegate steps' picks and as this asset's key.

skills.label: Skills
skills.description: List of {id, name, description, tags: [...], examples: [...]}. This is what a delegate step's picker LLM matches a task against.

version.label: Version
version.description: Agent version, A2A field name kept as-is.

capabilities.label: Capabilities
capabilities.description: Our OWN verb taxonomy (NOT part of A2A/MCP) -- e.g. critique, supervise, triage, translate, summarize, classify, lookup, extract, generate, code_review. A delegate step's required_capabilities pre-filters on this before any LLM is involved.

invocation.label: Invocation
invocation.description: Exactly one of mcp_server (+ tool_name, tool_args_template) or http. See component.py docstring for the full field shapes -- mcp_server mirrors agentic_pipeline's mcp_call.server, http mirrors agentic_pipeline's agent_call remote_agent kind, passed through unchanged.

asset_key_prefix.label: Asset Key Prefix
asset_key_prefix.description: Prefix for the emitted asset key.

name: Agent Card
